##### Project general facts

SLS Dubai Hotels & Residences is an iconic 75-story tower, making it one of the tallest hotels and residences in the region, developed in collaboration with international award-winning architects Aedas. The development offers spectacular, unobstructed views of the iconic Burj Khalifa and the calming Dubai Creek. Featuring a limited collection of ready-to-move-in, fully furnished serviced hotel apartments, SLS Dubai presents an opportunity to own the luxury that is the SLS lifestyle, encompassing the best of both worlds — unmatched luxury and enviable investment returns.

Residents enjoy access to ultimate exclusivity with hotel apartments sharing SLS Hotel's breathtaking views, intimate address, and quality services with added privacy. Amenities include two infinity pools, a day lounge, nightlife venues, public floors, exclusive access to the gym and rooftop infinity pools overlooking Downtown Dubai, dedicated concierge services, and housekeeping. Accor Diamond Membership, round-the-clock security, and parking allocation complete the offering. An extensive range of à la carte services including dry cleaning, valet parking, babysitting, exclusive spa indulgences, business center services, and signature SLS branded F&B experiences ensure every need is anticipated.

Every residence at SLS Dubai is designed with sophisticated elegance and refined aesthetic design. One-bedroom simplex apartments offer open-exhibition kitchens fit for entertaining, while one-bedroom lofts feature double-height ceilings over seven meters with stunning views. One-bedroom duplexes offer convenience and opulence with breathtaking city views, and two-bedroom duplexes exude cosmopolitan sophistication with glass corners in living rooms, bedrooms, and bathrooms for panoramic 180-degree views. Two-bedroom lofts display elegant open living spaces and gourmet-style kitchens. All residences are fully furnished with signature SLS luxury.


##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the vibrant Business Bay district, this exceptional location is at the heart of Dubai's commercial and residential hub, offering spectacular, unobstructed views of the iconic Burj Khalifa and the calming Dubai Creek. Business Bay is known as a very stylish and up-to-date community, where the fast-paced life seamlessly blends with waterfront serenity along the Dubai Water Canal.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and proximity to key destinations. Famous and international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and finance centers are just minutes away, elevating the standard of living with easy and intuitive options. The area hosts plenty of events, including music festivals and celebrations, keeping life lively and engaging throughout the year.

For those seeking a residence that embodies iconic luxury, unparalleled views, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live at the peak.
